column1: # Citations the citations gate must not fail on, one row per site (docs/status.md 3.172).
# A citation can be right and still pair with a snippet the gate had to guess at: the quoted
# identifier is an *example* on an include-line citation, or the cited range is right and the
# quote is the member's type.  Every row carries that reason; a row that no longer matches a
# finding is a failure, the same rule the other manifests use.  Columns:

column2: the range is right (dispextern.h 1445-1446 is OVERLAPS_PRED/OVERLAPS_SUCC) and the quote names the function that explains the two bits; the gate pairs a citation with the first code-like snippet on the line
coding.h 384-392 is struct coding_detection_info; the quoted `detector` is a member of struct coding_system (whose comment is why the range is cited)
coding.h 267-281 is the five CODING_MODE_* values; `mode` is the member they are stored in (262 is that member's comment)
coding.h 507-516 is the ten CODING_ANNOTATION_* values; `common_flags` is the member they land in (407)
coding.h 704 is make_string_from_utf8's prototype; `build_string_from_utf8` is the sentence's "who calls it" note
lisp.h 34 is an #include line and the quoted type is what that include brings in - the include-line class (the cm.c 23 shape the tool cannot judge)
lisp.h 4796 is `extern AVOID signal_error (...)`; the quoted `_Noreturn void` is how AVOID expands
composite.h 28 is an #include line (that is the cited text) and the quoted struct is what the include brings in
frame.h 1163-1226 is the FRAME_* read/write macro run; `bool_bf` is the type the cited flags are declared with (frame.h 331)
frame.h 1187 is FRAME_WINDOWS_FROZEN's definition; `bool_bf` is the type of the member it reads
verify.h 41/45 are the two _GL_HAVE__STATIC_ASSERT defines; `_Static_assert` is only mentioned in the 24 comment
verify.h 267-270 is the MSVC arm's _Static_assert definition; `_GL_STATIC_ASSERT_H` is the outer guard at 240
verify.h 323/334 are the two _GL_HAS_BUILTIN_* fallbacks; `assume` is the macro this paragraph discusses (368)
